title: Stories Cube
description: Full-screen stories that turn to the next person like the faces of a cube.
steps: `itemSize` is the width of the 9:16 page, and `itemAnimation` just lines the pages up side by side and hides any page at ±1 or beyond.

Inside each page, `relativeProgress` sets `rotateY` to value × 90° with `perspective` 900 per 330 pt of width, turning on the right edge when leaving and on the left edge when entering, so the faces meet like a cube.
`onSnapToItem` restarts the bar over the 4000 ms `autoplayInterval`, `onScrollStart` freezes it, and a tap on the left third or the rest of the card calls `ref.prev()` or `ref.next()`.
